retention_rule: Preserve only a reviewed delta that changes future behavior, proof, recovery, or reentry.
source_rule: Keep operator source, evidence, inference, unknown, invalidator, and supersession distinguishable.
acceptance_rule: The producing assistant cannot self-approve a capability or wider propagation.
resultant_rule: A terminal resultant becomes durable only through an independently accepted readback that preserves source positions, pre-projection correction, actual delta, possibility impact, next movement, effect state, and causal input concurrency.
self_improvement_rule: Self-improvement is an owner-governed assessment, never automatic promotion; improve requires evidence, pending evidence is verify_first, and competence or meta-competence forms remain revisable as context changes.
reciprocal_work_rule: Concrete work tests the competence that enables it; reviewed readback improves that competence; the improved competence must change a later movement to support assimilation.
cultivation_stop_rule: Do not add another competence level when it changes no material relation in comprehension, execution, proof, recovery, or reentry.
